description: This file defines exception handler functions for FastAPI, including handling for HTTP exceptions, request validation errors, and WebSocket validation errors.

methods.name: Response http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: HTTPException)
methods.description: Handles general HTTP exceptions, returning an appropriate Response or JSONResponse based on headers and status code.

methods.name: JSONResponse request_validation_exception_handler( request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError )
methods.description: Handles request validation errors by returning a JSON response with error details and 422 status code.

methods.name: None websocket_request_validation_exception_handler( websocket: WebSocket, exc: WebSocketRequestValidationError )
methods.description: Handles WebSocket validation errors by closing the WebSocket connection with a specific policy violation code and error details.

ctags.name: http_exception_handler
ctags.pattern: /^async def http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: HTTPException) -> Response:$/
